title: Q-FLEETMAP-second-tenant: ultrastable/second-tenant is not equal to its source (16 file(s) differ, 6 missing, 0 only in the copy)
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** fleetmap --drift --apply (daily in tenant-sync.yml)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation fleetmap --probe second-tenant
**Prediction:** fleet_map_drifted_repos <= 0 within 168 h
**Status:** open

ultrastable/second-tenant is a copy and is not equal to its source (FLEET-MAP-1): 16 file(s) differ, 6 missing, 0 only in the copy.

- differ: agents/AGENTS.md, bootstrap/bootstrap.py, worker/src/apprepos.js, worker/src/discover.js, worker/src/index.js, worker/src/lane.js, worker/src/lanemerge.js, worker/src/mergenow.js, worker/src/postfeedback.js, worker/src/social.js, worker/src/sweeper.js, worker/src/visibility.js ...
- missing: scripts/surfaces.py, standards/system.schema.json, worker/src/contract.js, worker/src/ghfetch.js, worker/test/contract.test.js, worker/test/ghfetch.test.js
- ultrastable.lock.json is missing: the kernel sync treats every changed file as a local edit and updates nothing

Fix the sync named in doctrine/fleet-map.json for this repository (never copy by hand), then the same reading closes this item.

**Closing probe:** cmd:python3 -m foundation fleetmap --probe second-tenant
